response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior generalist with a strong web/full-stack background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) but lacks nearly all of the core requirements for this role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese (only English, Romanian, and basic German listed), no Linux kernel analysis or modification experience, no networking/LAN-switch or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3, SNMP/NETCONF), and only brief, decade-old C/C++ work at National Instruments. While the general engineering seniority and embedded exposure are positive, the mismatch on the hard requirements — particularly the native Japanese language requirement, which is typically non-negotiable — makes this a poor fit.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and some embedded/hardware projects
Prior C/C++ work at National Instruments and Linux-based low-level projects (audio server, wave field synthesis)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, and demonstrated knowledge sharing
concerns: No Japanese language ability listed; role requires native-level proficiency
No Linux kernel investigation or source-modification experience demonstrated
No networking (L2/L3, switching) or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)

key_factors.factor: Minimal recent C / Linux kernel work
